name: MonarchSpinner
title: Spinner
summary: A 2dp ring with one open quarter that turns, for a short wait in a small space.
whenToUse: For a short wait in a small area, such as a list row or the center of a loading screen.
whenNotToUse: Inside a button use MonarchButton(loading = true). When the progress is known use a determinate MonarchProgress.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSpinner(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchSpinnerSize = MonarchSpinnerSize.Md, color: Color = LocalContentColor.current, label: String? = null)
enum class MonarchSpinnerSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: size
options.description: Sm 14dp, Md 16dp or Lg 24dp across; the stroke is 2dp.

options.name: color
options.description: The ring; the content color of the surrounding surface by default.

options.name: label
options.description: What is loading, for TalkBack. Null uses "Loading" (monarch_progress_loading); an empty string hides the spinner from TalkBack.

states.name: spinning
states.description: A ring with one open quarter, one turn in 0.7 seconds.

states.name: still
states.description: With animations removed in the system settings the ring stands still.

appearance: The ring is drawn in the current content color: the label color inside a button, the text color elsewhere unless color is set.
platformNotes: The web Spinner. iOS uses the system ProgressView. For an indeterminate or determinate bar or ring that shows progress, use MonarchProgress.
accessibility: Announced as an indeterminate progress bar named Loading, or the label.
Not a live region; announce the start of a long wait in text if it matters.
edgeCases: With animations removed in the system settings the ring does not move.
